units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲极口赞美：“这大将相貌真美丽啊！”

en.t: Ukifune's mother praised him to the skies: "How truly beautiful this General looks!"

units.source_text: 她想：“乳母往常突然想起这人时，就劝我把浮舟嫁给他。

en.t: She thought, "Whenever the nurse happened to remember this man, she would urge me to marry Ukifune to him.

units.source_text: 我总认为是荒唐之言，向不理睬。

en.t: I always thought it was absurd talk and paid it no attention.

units.source_text: 现在看到了他这相貌，觉得即使隔着银河，一年只逢一度，也情愿把女儿嫁给这光辉灿烂的牵牛星。

en.t: Now that I have seen his face, I would gladly marry my daughter to this radiant Altair, even if they were separated by the Milky Way and met only once a year.

units.source_text: 我这女儿长得这般美貌，嫁给寻常人实甚可惜。

en.t: My daughter has grown into such a beauty that it would be a terrible pity to marry her to an ordinary man.

units.source_text: 只因在东国看惯了那些粗蛮的武士，以为那左近少将是优秀人物。”

en.t: Only because I had grown used to those rough warriors in the eastern provinces did I think that Sakon no Shosho was an excellent man."
She regretted how shallow her judgment had been at the time.

units.source_text: 薰大将所倚靠过的罗汉松木柱、所坐过的垫子，都染上了异常美妙的余香，说起来别人还道是故意夸张。

en.t: The podocarp pillar General Kaoru had leaned against and the cushion he had sat on were both steeped in an unusually exquisite lingering fragrance, so much so that others would think it deliberate exaggeration if one spoke of it.

units.source_text: 连常常拜见他的侍女们，也没有一次不极口赞美。

en.t: Even the serving women who often attended him never failed to praise him lavishly.

units.source_text: 有的人说：“阅读佛经，知道种种殊胜功德之中，香气芬芳最为尊贵。

en.t: One person said, "When one reads the Buddhist scriptures, one learns that among all the wondrous virtues, a fragrant scent is the most noble.

units.source_text: 佛菩萨说这话确是有道理的。

en.t: There is certainly reason in the Buddhas and bodhisattvas saying this.

units.source_text: 《药王品》等经文中，言之更详，说有一种毛孔里出来的香气叫作‘牛头旃檀’。

en.t: In scriptures such as the Medicine King chapter, this is explained in still greater detail, saying that there is a fragrance issuing from the pores called 'ox-head sandalwood.'

units.source_text: 这名称虽然可怕，但确有其事，眼前这薰大将便是证据，可见佛说是真实的。

en.t: Although the name sounds fearsome, the thing truly exists, and this General Kaoru before our eyes is the proof, showing that the Buddha's words are true.

units.source_text: 这位薰大将想必从小就勤修佛法吧。”

en.t: This General Kaoru must surely have practiced the Buddhist law diligently since childhood."

units.source_text: 又有人说：“不知他前世积了多少功德呢。”

en.t: Another person said, "Who knows how much merit he accumulated in his previous life?"

units.source_text: 她们众口交誉，浮舟的母亲听了不知不觉地面露笑容。

en.t: As they all praised him with one voice, Ukifune's mother listened and, before she knew it, a smile appeared on her face.
